import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Complex Filter Function Metric Finset
open scoped BigOperators Topology

theorem cubic_denominator_linear_growth_convergence (a : ℕ → ℂ) (C : ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖a n‖ ≤ C * (n + 1 : ℝ))
    (s : ℕ → ℂ)
    (h : s = (fun n : ℕ => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, a i / (i + 1 : ℂ) ^ 3)) :
    ∃ y, Tendsto s atTop (𝓝 y) := by
  have hs0 : Summable (fun n : ℕ => 1 / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) :=
    (Real.summable_one_div_nat_pow (p := 2)).2 (by norm_num)
  
  have hs1 : Summable (fun n : ℕ => 1 / ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
    simpa [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using
      (summable_nat_add_iff 1).2 hs0
  
  have hs : Summable (fun n : ℕ => C * (1 / ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2)) :=
    hs1.mul_left C
  
  have hsum : Summable (fun i : ℕ => a i / (i + 1 : ℂ) ^ 3) := by
    apply hs.of_norm_bounded
    intro i
  
    have hbound : ‖a i‖ ≤ C * ((i : ℝ) + 1) := by
      simpa using ha i
  
    have hnorm : ‖(i + 1 : ℂ)‖ = ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      norm_num [Complex.norm_def, Complex.normSq]
      rw [show (↑i + 1) * (↑i + 1) = ((↑i + 1 : ℝ) ^ 2) by ring]
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg]
      positivity
  
    rw [norm_div, norm_pow, hnorm]
  
    calc
      ‖a i‖ / ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 3 ≤
          (C * ((i : ℝ) + 1)) / ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 3 := by
            exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hbound (by positivity)
      _ = C * (1 / ((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
        norm_num [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
        field_simp
  
  refine ⟨∑' i : ℕ, a i / (i + 1 : ℂ) ^ 3, ?_⟩
  rw [h]
  exact hsum.hasSum.tendsto_sum_nat

    ∃ y, Tendsto s atTop (𝓝 y) := by

  let f : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => a n / (n + 1 : ℂ) ^ 3
  have hbase : Summable (fun n : ℕ => (1 : ℝ) / (n + 1 : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
    have hnat : Summable (fun n : ℕ => (1 : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) :=
      (Real.summable_one_div_nat_pow (p := 2)).2 (by norm_num)
    simpa [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using
      (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mpr hnat
  have hmajorant : Summable (fun n : ℕ => C / (n + 1 : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
    simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using hbase.mul_left C
  have hnorm_bound : ∀ n : ℕ, ‖f n‖ ≤ C / (n + 1 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
    intro n
    have hden : ‖(n + 1 : ℂ) ^ 3‖ = (n + 1 : ℝ) ^ 3 := by
      rw [norm_pow]
      have hn : ‖(n + 1 : ℂ)‖ = (n + 1 : ℝ) := by
        simpa [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using
          (Complex.norm_natCast (n + 1))
      rw [hn]

      ‖f n‖ = ‖a n‖ / (n + 1 : ℝ) ^ 3 := by
        simp [f, hden]
      _ ≤ (C * (n + 1 : ℝ)) / (n + 1 : ℝ) ^ 3 := by
        exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (ha n) (by positivity)
      _ = C / (n + 1 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
        field_simp
  have hfSummable : Summable f :=
    Summable.of_norm_bounded hmajorant hnorm_bound
  refine ⟨∑' n, f n, ?_⟩
  have hpartial :
      Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, f k)
        atTop (𝓝 (∑' n, f n)) :=
    hfSummable.hasSum.tendsto_sum_nat
  simpa [h, f] using hpartial
